ops.body: 2026-08-29 triage: no-longer-relevant. \`retireUntrusted\` never landed on origin/main — \`git log --oneline -S "retireUntrusted" --remotes -- deploy/deploy.go\` in daemonkit returns nothing; the two commits that ever contained it (f30798d, d32b9ae, both 2026-08-19) exist only under abandoned \`refs/jj/keep/*\` refs, never merged. The design it argues against (a narrow eviction path scoped to "the refusing daemon") does not exist either: current Reset() (deploy/deploy.go:427-462) documents full, unconditional eviction as its deliberate contract — "launchd is converged empty... It is the way out of a state no other verb accepts" — and the same \`quiesceAndConverge(ctx, nil)\` primitive it calls is shared verbatim by Install-supersede (deploy.go:245), Uninstall (deploy.go:365), and swap-resume (swap.go:126), none gated on a trust refusal. There is no Trust.Control-refusal-specific recovery path left to scope.
